reply_text:
I couldn't give Dana a settled seat count, so I told her in a #north-team thread reply to hold off updating the tracker.

**What I found:** Ilse posted 261 seats in the channel on 10/14, but none of the Quarrendon records back that up:
- **2026 renewal order form** (signed 3/20, effective 4/1): it doesn't state a seat count at all.
- **Account profile** (last updated 9/30): it shows 185 active seats.
- **Amendment No. 3** (signed 9/22): it raises the count to 230 seats, starting 2027-01-01.

So the documents show 185 seats now and 230 from January. I suggested Dana check with June on the deal desk, and in the same reply I asked Ilse to say where 261 came from.

My mistake on 10/14: I acknowledged Ilse's 261 without checking it against the records, and I said so in the reply to Dana.

I left the renewal prices out of the reply. Dana owns the account, but Marcus Lindqvist can also read #north-team, so posting them there would need Anselm or June's approval.
